## Features
- Heavy-duty white rubber cable, waterproof
- Connectable up to 50m for custom displays
- Energy-saving leds with warm white glow

## Information
Create a magical atmosphere with these Warm White LED Icicle Lights, designed with a striking 60/40/20cm drop pattern and finished on durable white rubber cable. Part of our mains voltage light system, these icicle lights are built for both indoor and outdoor use, making them a versatile option for year-round decoration. With the ability to connect multiple sets together, you can easily tailor the length to suit anything from a small porch or pergola to a full house frontage. Manufactured with heavy-duty rubber cable and waterproof ends, these icicle lights are weather-resistant and suitable for all seasons. The long-life LED bulbs provide a bright yet warm glow that enhances the charm of your outdoor or indoor setting, while also being energy efficient and reliable. Available in 2m and 5m sections, these connectable lights allow you to achieve up to 50m of continuous display with ease. Perfect for adding elegance to gutters, eaves, patios, garden structures or festive displays, they are equally at home enhancing summer evenings as they are creating a festive winter scene. Whether you choose to install them permanently or bring them out for special occasions, these Warm White Icicle Lights are designed to deliver long-lasting performance and an inviting glow that transforms any space.

Built to withstand the elements and designed for ease of use, they bring dependable, stylish lighting to any setting.

## Features
- LED Hanging Icicle Christmas Lights with icicle effect
- Choice of 135, 240, 360, 480, 720, 1000, or 2000 LEDs
- Available in 5 colours to suit your festive theme
- 8 light sequences with timer and memory function
- 5m cable to easily plug indoors for outdoor display

## Information
Create a magical festive display with these LED Hanging Icicle Christmas Lights from Christow. Available in a choice of lengths and colours, they feature hanging strands of sparkling LEDs to capture the look of shimmering icicles. Perfect for decorating rooflines, windows, mantels, and other indoor and outdoor spaces, with eight light settings and a built-in timer to effortlessly light up your home this Christmas. Sparkling Icicle Light Display Beautifully illuminated by strands of 5mm LEDs to capture the look of sparkling icicles and create a spectacular festive display. Although the LEDs are ultra-bright for an enchanting festive glow, they're also low power, energy efficient, and low cost to run. 8 Light Sequences with Memory Create the perfect festive mood by choosing from eight light settings, from a steady static glow to sparkling twinkles and flashing displays. A built-in memory function remembers your last setting, so the lights are always ready to shine your way. Built-In Timer Function Enjoy hassle-free festive lighting with a built-in timer function. Simply activate the timer and the lights will automatically light up at the same time each evening before switching off six hours later. You can also manually operate them whenever you choose. Mains Powered with 5m Cable Powered by an IP20-rated UK transformer plug for indoor sockets only. A generous 5m white cable allows flexible placement when displaying the lights outdoors, while remaining discreet against white guttering, window frames and fences.
